import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] m;
        int size;

        Matrix(int size) {
            this.size = size;
            m = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(this.size);
            for (int i = 0; i <= this.size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= this.size; ++j) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= this.size; ++k) {
                        sum += (long) this.m[i][k] * other.m[k][j];
                    }
                    res.m[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();

        int[] digits = new int[70];
        int count = 0;
        while (N != 0) {
            digits[count++] = (int) (N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        Matrix[][] matArr = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];
        Matrix[][] prefixArr = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];
        Matrix[][] suffixArr = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
                matArr[0][i] = new Matrix((int) K);
                for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row)
                    for (int col = 0; col <= K; ++col)
                        matArr[0][i].m[row][col] = 0;
                matArr[0][i].m[j][j] = 1;
                matArr[0][i].m[j][(int) i] = 1;
            }
            matArr[0][i] = new Matrix((int) K);
            for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row)
                for (int col = 0; col <= K; ++col)
                    matArr[0][i].m[row][col] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
                matArr[0][i].m[j][j] = 1;
                matArr[0][i].m[j][(int) i] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            prefixArr[0][i] = matArr[0][i];
            suffixArr[0][i] = matArr[0][i];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i)
            prefixArr[0][i] = prefixArr[0][i - 1].multiply(matArr[0][i]);

        for (int i = (int) K - 2; i >= 0; --i)
            suffixArr[0][i] = matArr[0][i].multiply(suffixArr[0][i + 1]);

        for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            int idx = i;
            matArr[idx][0] = suffixArr[idx - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
                matArr[idx][j] = suffixArr[idx - 1][j].multiply(prefixArr[idx - 1][j - 1]);

            prefixArr[idx][0] = matArr[idx][0];
            suffixArr[idx][(int) K - 1] = matArr[idx][(int) K - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
                prefixArr[idx][j] = prefixArr[idx][j - 1].multiply(matArr[idx][j]);

            for (int j = (int) K - 2; j >= 0; --j)
                suffixArr[idx][j] = matArr[idx][j].multiply(suffixArr[idx][j + 1]);
        }

        Matrix finalMat = new Matrix((int) K);
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i)
            finalMat.m[0][i] = 0;
        finalMat.m[0][(int) K] = 1;
        finalMat.size = (int) K;

        finalMat = finalMat.multiply(prefixArr[count - 1][digits[count - 1] - 1]);

        int lastDigit = digits[count - 1];
        for (int i = count - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; ++j)
                finalMat = finalMat.multiply(matArr[i][(j + lastDigit) % K]);
            lastDigit += digits[i];
        }

        long sumRes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i)
            sumRes += finalMat.m[0][i];

        System.out.println(sumRes % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
